body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P_n\) and fixed \((\widehat g,\widehat q)\in\mathcal H_n(P)\), \(E_P[(Y-\widehat q(X))(T-\widehat g(X))]-\theta_0=E_P[(\widehat g(X)-g_0(X))(\widehat q(X)-q_0(X))]\), whose absolute value is at most \(\varepsilon_{g,n}\varepsilon_{q,n}\).
body.justification: The identity makes known unit residual variance a safe unnormalized DML branch.
body.gap: Normalized DML analyses estimate a denominator; this exact identity supplies the coverage-preserving fallback here.
body.consumer: It gives a valid interval for analysts using slow black-box nuisance fits.
